name: Healing Pool · Death · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.62-block radius for 22.5 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 12 s
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Growth: up to 10 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4.5 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
